data.jd_text:
**About noon** 




 noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform. Since its launch on December 12th, 2017, in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and its expansion into Egypt in February 2019, noon has grown into a diverse ecosystem spanning marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. noon is a work in progress \- six years in, but only 5% done.
 



  





**noon’s mission:** 
 Ring every doorbell, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.



  





 Is this you?

**Department:**

**What The Hiring Manager Says**
*“The GSMA’s MENA team is expanding and we have an exciting opportunity for a high\-performing Policy Director to work with the MENA team to engage all stakeholders with GSMA programs and policy \& technology orientated activities. The role entails a lot of travel, ability to work under pressure and a deep technical and policy background”.*
 Head of MENA
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a creative and energetic Director to lead GSMA programmes in the Middle East and North Africa. The Director will be responsible for advancing GSMA’s objectives in the MENA region. This will involve leading engagements on policy and regulations as well as being the technical expert and reference point for broader GSMA activities both within the organisation and in relations with our members. You will need to demonstrate clear understanding of mobile industry comfortable communicating this at a range of levels of detail. You will also be required to attend some GSMA working groups when needed, to provide descriptions of general industry topics and specific GSMA projects. You may be required to attend meetings of other industry forums.
   

  

 You will have a good understanding of existing and future mobile technology and be able to demonstrate knowledge of the future industry trends and their likely impacts on mobile network evolution and development. You will be able to articulate potential industry positions in areas of confluence of Mobile with other verticals, including, but not limited to, banking and finance, healthcare, education, and other service industries where mobile technology plays a critical role in shifting paradigms for solution delivery.
   

  

 You will also be able to demonstrate the ability to understand the commercial implications of technical decisions and vice versa.
   

  

 You will also engage all stakeholders with GSMA Technology programmes and technology orientated activities (MC, IoT, RCS, 5G, IMEI, Mobile Money, etc.).
   

  

 The Policy Director reports to the Head of MENA. This role works very closely with the rest of the small MENA team.
   

  

**You Will**
* Lead industry engagement and projects on spectrum and policy matters as well as broader GSMA activities in region.
* Manage Working Group and Regional Interest Group activity in region.
* Engage with member leadership in region.
* Responsible for input towards regional business planning.
* Manage programme delivery in region against HQ KPIs and member expectations.
* Responsible for delivering within the annual regional budget allocation.
* Responsible for regional reporting in accordance with HQ requirements, presenting progress against regional KPIs and defining corrective action where appropriate.
* Foster the necessary consultation, communications and good relations within the wider organisation, including staff of member organisations.
* Line and performance management of regional team.
* Ability to work cooperatively and flexibly with stakeholders and facilitate a collaborative approach.
* Acts as a role model in demonstrating commitment to GSMA values and internal processes.
* Ensure compliance by team with all GSMA polices, processes and procedures.


**About You**
* Relevant experience working in the telecoms industry is essential. Ideally with an operator or vendor.
* Strong technical plus commercial understanding background.
* Capable of delivering presentations to a technical audience on these services.
* You will be fluent in English. Arabic and/or French would be an advantage.
* A proven track record of proposition development and the ability to influence and add value to your area of business.
* Strong writing skills, messaging, leadership positioning and narrative development.
* Experience working in an international environment, ideally in the MENA/SSA region.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Experience of working with multiple internal stakeholders and with geographically dispersed teams in a matrix structure.
* Willingness to travel, as and when required by the role.


**About Your Skills**
* Communication
* Delivery
* Project Management
* Teamwork
* Analysis


**Contract type**
 Department Contractor
   

  

**Worker type**
 Contingent Worker
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast\-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry\-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.
   

  

 In addition to architect\-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning \& development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.
   

  

 To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.
   

  

 Being You at the GSMA
   

  

 We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well\-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi\-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.
   

  

**GSMA Values**
 Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.
   

  

**Passionately driven**
 We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world\-changing impact.
   

  

**Insightful leaders**
 We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.
   

  

**Stronger together**
 We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.
   

  

 Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

*Join our Re Energize program at Siemens Energy, where you can reignite your career in a dynamic and forward\-thinking organization*
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Bid Manager in Gas Services, you will engage with diverse stakeholders across the Middle East to develop technical and commercial offerings within the pricing guidelines and commercial governance requirements of Siemens Energy. You will work on meaningful projects that enhance the efficiency and reliability of gas and steam turbines, directly contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of decarbonizing global energy systems. Expect a dynamic team culture that values collaboration, diversity, and personal growth, empowering you to make a significant impact on our clients and partners while shaping the energy landscape of tomorrow.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* In your new role as a Bid Project Manager in Gas Service, you are responsible for the overall Bid Process for Open Market Offerings and potentially Long\-Term Service Program bids within the Sales organization for the Region Middle East
* Develop a complete understanding of the organization structure and key buying influences of assigned account and work out the complete technical proposal and coordinate the input from the project team during the bidding process and incorporate the commercial and legal part of the proposal in the overall bid structure.
* Support the Sales colleagues in the internal Limits of Authority process (LoA process) and set up the bid structure in internal ERP system
* Align with Business Administration Colleagues regarding tax concepts and Business models. Prepare sales proposals for products and service opportunities. You analyze and evaluate the customer requirements and/or RFQ documents and work out best\-fitting bidding strategies together with the Sales colleagues and all other required parties.
* Support the Sales colleagues in finding the best bid strategy. Furthermore, coordination of all service\-related topics with the relevant interfaces is required. Maintain customer and distributor contact, providing comprehensive technical product application assistance.
* Take an active part in the contract negotiations together with the Sales colleagues and hand over the projects to the project execution team. Perform cost and risk assessments and finalize the bid documents


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s Degree or a Master’s degree in Engineering with at least 5 years’ experience in the Power Generation Sector and are experienced with Gas\-Steam Turbines, Generators and aftermarket services and general experience in Project implementation and Outage management is a plus
* Good experience with processes involved in technical, commercial and legal clarification of an offer and experience of collaboration with Siemens Regional Companies and / or external Partners preferred.
* You can understand customer requirements and can communicate these effectively within Siemens Energy organization
* You can work in an international environment; you have excellent communication skills and speak English, Arabic language is preferred.

* We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical
 **Project Manager** 
 to join our Medical Underwriting team. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluating and underwriting group medical insurance risks, supporting business growth while ensuring profitability, compliance, and exceptional service standards.



  





**Required Qualifications and Skills:** 



* 6\-8 years' experience in project management
* IT and software experience
* Preferred in insurance industry

* Relevant experience in IT project management, software development, or systems implementation including:



 1\) project planning and scheduling
 



 2\) Risk assessment and mitigation

* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Stakeholder management
* Presentation and reporting
* Vendor and contract management



  





**Responsibilities:** 





 • Own and actively manage assigned projects within the workstream, maintaining end\-to\-end accountability for timelines, delivery paths, and execution milestones
 





 • Define granular project objectives, write Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), and detail technical and functional requirements in collaboration with the Project Owner
 





 • Track day\-to\-day operational risks and issues, manage localized escalations, and proactively remove bottlenecks to keep the delivery engine moving
 





 • Support/manage the preparation of RFPs, manage project costs, and track day\-to\-day expenditures against specific project deliverables
 





 • Coordinate cross\-functional stakeholder meetings, maintain rigorous communication across teams, and generate regular, data\-driven status and progress reports

 • Escalate complex problems to the relevant stakeholder to ensure case/issue is closed efficiently and in a timely manner
 





 • Participate in planning, scheduling and monitoring of simple project activities to ensure alignment to requirements
 





 • Participate in managing the delivery of the project according to the project plan to ensure the delivery of project deliverables is within the agreed\-on time, budget, and quality

 • Ensure strict adherence to quality standards, framework compliance, and seamless operational readiness/integration within the business
 





 • Develop and maintain project management documents such as project charter, project governance and project implementation plan, certificate of completion etc.
 





 • Coordinate with functions to identify project requirements, goals, scope, resources and budget
 





 • Gather information on projects activities and assist in preparing standard reports for progress update
 





 • Ensure continuous update of the database of projects for maintenance and monitoring purposes and consolidate all technical reports relevant to project management for future, references and record keeping.
 








**Why Join Us?** 




 At Takaful Emarat, you will play a critical role in strengthening our Sharia governance framework and ensuring the highest standards of compliance across the organization. This is an opportunity to contribute to a leading Takaful provider committed to integrity, transparency, and ethical business practices.

**Position Snapshot** 




 Title: Project Development Manager
 



 Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 



 Position Type: Full Time
 



  





**How will your day look like?** 




 As a Project Development Manager, you will lead end\-to\-end product development and commercialization projects across both New Product Development (NPD) and Existing Product Development (EPD) portfolios. You will work closely with R\&D, Sales, Marketing, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to transform customer and business requirements into commercially successful product launches. From project planning and governance to stakeholder alignment, risk management, and stage\-gate execution, you will ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards while driving seamless commercialization and sustainable business growth.
 



  





**How Will You Make an Impact?** 



* Lead end\-to\-end Existing Product Development (EPD) and commercialization projects, ensuring successful execution from customer brief to product launch.
* Drive multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and in line with business and customer requirements.
* Partner with R\&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Translate customer and commercial requirements into structured project plans, coordinating activities across all stakeholders.
* Drive project governance, manage risks, and ensure effective stage\-gate execution throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Lead Private Label and customer\-specific development projects, ensuring timely approvals and launch readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve project efficiency, reduce lead times, and enhance cross\-functional collaboration.



  





**Education \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience leading end\-to\-end product development and commercialization projects within the Food \& Beverage industry.
* Proven experience managing Existing Product Development (EPD) and/or New Product Development (NPD) projects from concept to commercialization.
* Experience managing Private Label and/or Branded product development projects.
* Demonstrated success in leading cross\-functional projects and delivering outcomes on time and within budget.
* PMP certification and/or a relevant Master's degree will be an advantage.



  





**Grow with Agthia – For the Better** 




 Agthia Group is one of the region’s leading Food \& Beverage companies, with a steadily growing international footprint. From our roots in Abu Dhabi, we’ve built a diverse portfolio of over 35 market\-leading brands across Water \& Food, Snacking, Protein \& Frozen, and Agri\-Business – touching the lives of millions of consumers in more than 65 global markets. With sustainability at the core of our innovations, we’ve pioneered several world\-first products, setting new benchmarks in the industry and meeting the evolving needs of communities worldwide.
 



  





 Over 12,000 people from more than 67 nationalities are at the heart of shaping our purpose driven future, supported by an agile environment which encourages collaboration, creativity, and the freedom to make a real difference. With a competitive benefits package, genuine opportunities to advance, and, a focus on continuous learning and development, we’re committed to supporting your growth as we work together to deliver excellence “For the Better.”

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an exceptional Director of Inclusion – Whole School to join our team at GEMS Wellington Academy – Al Khail from January 2027
   

  

 Our vision at GEMS Wellington Academy Al Khail is to "Empower today, for a limitless tomorrow." We are seeking an outstanding leader who can help us achieve this goal through our belief in: Limitless Learning, Limitless Solutions, and Limitless Possibilities.
   

  

 As a cognitive science\-driven school, evidence\-informed practice is at the heart of everything we do. We are looking for an experienced Inclusion leader who can articulate a clear vision for outstanding inclusive education, ensuring every learner can thrive academically, socially and emotionally. Successful candidates will share our core values of Ambition, Responsibility and Courage and be passionate about creating a truly inclusive learning environment for all.
   

  

 The Director of Inclusion will provide strategic leadership for inclusive provision across our through\-school, leading the development of exceptional practice for Students of Determination while ensuring full compliance with the Dubai Inclusive Education Policy Framework. Working closely with the Senior Leadership Team, teachers, parents and external agencies, the successful candidate will drive a culture where inclusion is embedded in every aspect of school life.
   

  

 Successful candidates will be joining a fully inclusive, high\-performing school that is evidenced through:
   

  

* GCSE and A\-Level results far exceeding UK national averages
* 'Very Good' rating from the Dubai Schools Inspection Bureau (DSIB)
* Outstanding rating from British Schools Overseas (BSO)
* 'World Class School' status from High Performance Learning
* Being an invited member of the Cognitive Science School Network


 Through our comprehensive professional learning programme, we ensure our leaders have access to high\-quality development opportunities that not only support their own professional growth but also contribute to our continued success. StepLab instructional coaching, the Cognitive Science Network, Schools, Students and Teachers Network (SSAT), the Best Practice Network (BPN) and Evidence Based Education (EBE) are just some of the organisations we work with to ensure our staff continue to develop as outstanding practitioners and leaders.
   

  

**Skills Description**
 Successful candidates will need to:
   

  

* Hold a recognised teaching qualification (PGCE, PGDE or equivalent) together with a Bachelor's degree in Education or a relevant field.
* Hold a recognised postgraduate qualification in Special Educational Needs, Inclusion or a related discipline (Master's degree or equivalent preferred).
* Have significant experience leading Inclusion within a high\-performing international school.
* Demonstrate an excellent understanding of the British curriculum and inclusive practice across a through\-school setting (ages 3–18\).
* Have a proven track record of developing high\-quality provision for Students of Determination.
* Possess strong knowledge of the Dubai Inclusive Education Policy Framework, KHDA expectations and current international best practice.
* Have experience leading multidisciplinary Inclusion teams, including SEN, EAL and specialist support staff.
* Demonstrate expertise in developing and monitoring Individual Education Plans (IEPs), intervention programmes and evidence\-informed support strategies.
* Be highly skilled in coaching teachers and leading professional development to embed outstanding inclusive classroom practice.
* Be an exceptional communicator, able to build strong relationships with students, families, colleagues and external agencies.
* Have excellent analytical skills with the ability to use data to evaluate provision and improve outcomes for all learners.
* Demonstrate a growth mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement and innovation.


 All positions attract an excellent remuneration package including a competitive tax\-free salary, individual fully furnished accommodation, free schooling, private medical insurance, annual airfares to country of residence and end of Service Gratuity.
   

  

 GEMS teachers and leaders also have free access to our loyalty app, GEMS Rewards, which provides significant savings on day\-to\-day life in the UAE. Employees benefit from thousands of discounts and 2\-for\-1 offers on flights, hotels, restaurants and retail outlets, making your salary go further and enhancing your opportunity to save whilst working overseas.
   

  

 GEMS Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all of its students and staff. A UK\-enhanced DBS or equivalent police check is a pre\-requisite for all appointments.

**About Jumeirah** 




 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About Jumeirah Burj Al Arab:** 




 Jumeirah Burj Al Arab is more than a hotel, it is a global icon of luxury hospitality. Since opening in 1999, it has defined the pinnacle of the industry, setting new benchmarks in personalised service and creating truly unforgettable guest experiences.
 



 Today, it enters a bold and defining new chapter. After more than 25 years at the forefront of the industry, the property will undergo a carefully considered restoration led by renowned designer Tristan Auer, bringing a refined contemporary vision while preserving the legacy, craftsmanship, and spirit of this extraordinary landmark.
 



  





**About the Job** 




 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a
 **Director of Learning \& Development** 
 to join
 **Jumeirah Burj Al Arab** 
 .
 



 The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:
 



  




* Define and lead the Learning \& Development strategy for Jumeirah Burj Al Arab at a pivotal moment in its restoration journey, shaping the capability, mindset, and service culture required to relaunch one of the world’s most iconic luxury hotels.
* Partner closely with the Director of HR and senior leadership team to translate the property’s restoration roadmap, operational readiness priorities, and renewed brand ambitions into a focused people\-development agenda.
* Lead high\-volume onboarding, re\-induction, and colleague integration with the discipline of a luxury pre\-opening environment, ensuring every colleague is immersed in the Burj Al Arab legacy, service philosophy, brand rituals, and elevated guest experience standards.
* Prepare leaders and colleagues for the next chapter of the property by building the behaviours, confidence, and operational capability required to deliver consistent, intuitive, and highly personalised service at scale.
* Embed a refreshed culture of excellence across all functions, connecting learning to service consistency, colleague engagement, operational readiness, guest experience, and the successful reopening of a landmark luxury property.
* Build a future\-ready talent pipeline through succession planning, career development, and high\-potential programmes that support business continuity, internal mobility, and leadership strength before, during, and beyond the restoration phase.
* Champion innovation across the learning landscape, using modern learning solutions, digital tools, best practices, and measurable insights to enhance capability, colleague experience, service consistency, and overall business performance throughout the hotel’s transformation journey.



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 



  




* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Learning \& Development, including at least 3–5 years in a leadership role within luxury hospitality.
* Demonstrated success in designing and delivering leadership development, capability\-building, and succession planning initiatives that strengthen organisational performance and prepare future leaders.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience partnering with senior leadership teams to drive organisational change, talent growth, and cultural transformation.
* Passion for developing people and creating exceptional colleague experiences, combined with a forward\-thinking approach to learning innovation, digital learning solutions, and modern development practices.
* Strong commercial and operational awareness, with the ability to align learning priorities to business objectives, service excellence standards, and colleague engagement goals.



  





**About the Benefits** 




 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.
 



 Benefits include:
 



  




* Supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to Learning \& Development programmes and clear career pathways
* Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network
* Colleague discounts on food, beverage, and hotel stays worldwide
* Comprehensive healthcare and life insurance coverage
* Paid annual leave entitlement
* Incentive programmes aligned with leadership performance
* Competitive tax\-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED)

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
   

  

 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
   

  

 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
   

  

 As the Director of MENA Public Policy you will develop and implement an engagement strategy with key policymakers, stakeholders, and opinion leaders across MENA. The successful candidate will oversee critical issues including, but not limited to, gaming, child safety, artificial intelligence, privacy, and consumer protection.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, driven to develop and execute creative strategies that advance Roblox’s business and priorities within the region. This position is based in Dubai and reports directly to the Head of Public Policy, Europe and MENA. The Director of MENA Public Policy will play a critical part in shaping Roblox's future in the country by establishing and executing effective public policy strategies. This role is instrumental in ensuring compliance, addressing policy issues, and fostering strong relationships with external partners, ultimately contributing to a safer and more engaging environment for Roblox's global community of developers and creators.
   

  

**You Will**
* Maintain and build relationships with regional policymakers and political figures
* Identify, monitor, and analyze policy issues affecting Roblox in MENA
* Develop and execute policy strategies around issues important to Roblox
* Assist the wider public policy team on ongoing projects and initiatives
* Advise Roblox internal stakeholders on policy matters as inputs to the development of our products and business operations
* Articulate Roblox’s public policy positions and produce briefing papers and consultation responses
* Empowered to fully pursue both your personal life and career goals, with support to take on increasing responsibilities and calculated risks for growth


**You Have**
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Political Science, Public Policy, Law, International Relations, Media, Technology, or related field of study or equivalent
* 10\+ years of experience working with policymakers and stakeholders in MENA
* Deep knowledge of the MENA policymaking and public opinion process
* Extensive experience in intelligence collection and analysis, strategy development, project management, cross\-functional partnership
* Strong communication skills, verbal and written


**You Are**
* Passionate about public policy issues in MENA
* A solutions\-driven and results\-oriented strategic thinker
* A dynamic and engaging presenter with stellar oral delivery
* Detail\-oriented, with strong communication, planning and organizational skills
* Self\-directed, with the ability to define your own work and processes
* A team player, who values collaboration and partnership
* You are a professional who approaches every individual as a client, regardless of their position, maintaining a calm and professional demeanor


 Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
   

  

 Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
   

  

 For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H\-1B sponsorship at this time.

data.jd_text:
We have a very exciting
 **Executive Director – Head of Property** 
 Facultative Reinsurance Broker role
 **based in Dubai** 
 at SHIELDS Reinsurance Brokers Ltd, regulated by the DFSA and admitted at Lloyd's of London.
 



  
 



 You will undertake advisory work and play an active role in broking contracts. You will be involved in both the assessment of our clients’ risk and the financial implications of the solutions we propose.
 








**Types of Insurance / Lines:** 




 1\.    Property Insurance
 



  
 



**Job Description Facultative Reinsurance Broker:** 









 ·       Produce new business and work alongside senior team members on the successful placement of new and renewal business.
 



 ·       Facilitate the compilation of submission information in conjunction with senior management.
 



 ·       Prepare broking slip, review underwriting submission, obtain quotations, negotiate renewals and finalise placements with reinsurers.
 



 ·       Negotiate scope of coverage, including policy extensions, limitations, exclusions, and subjectivities while achieving cost\-effective coverage.
 



 ·       Understand and manage clients’ needs and be able to advise clients with (re)insurance purchasing strategies.
 



 ·       Analyse clients’ requirements to identify appropriate reinsurance coverage and support placement strategy.
 



 ·       Negotiate with underwriters to place reinsurance structures that best suit our client’s needs.
 



 ·       Maintain constant contact with clients and reinsurers.
 



 ·       Work with the existing client service teams on the day\-to\-day handling of an account dealing with enquires and endorsements on new and existing placements.
 



 ·       Prepare and maintain technical documentation and ensure risks and documentation conform to regulatory requirements. You will be responsible for producing and checking the technical documentation, Open Market, Lineslips and Binding Authorities as well as producing and review of wordings and drafting amendments.
 



 ·       Establish professional working relationships and communicate effectively with colleagues, clients and relevant external contacts.
 



 ·       Adhere to all best practices and highest standards of professionalism and ethical behaviour in all activities.
 



 ·       Prepare client's and markets presentations in Excel, Word and PowerPoint formats.
 



  
 



  
 



  
 **Experience / Requirements:** 









**·** 
        Native or Bilingual English speaker with Arabic and/or French is a requirement.
 



 ·       Experience with reinsurance broking or placement is a must.
 



 ·       Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and PowerPoint)
 



 ·       Quick to learn new skills, comfortable communicating with clients and reinsurers, doing technical work, data analysis and contract work.
 



  
 



  
 



**Qualifications:** 









**Holding a diploma in Higher Education with minimum 10 years’ experience as a reinsurance placing broker or relevant industry experience.** 




**Preferably with professional qualification of ACll or ENASS or working towards.** 









**Skills:** 









**The candidate will be expected to interact regularly with clients in order to successfully originate and complete each transaction, with an ability to operate independently and technically capable of the work required to be completed.** 









**·** 
        Self\-motivated.
 



 ·       Good interpersonal skills, able to build strong business relationships.
 



 ·       Strong verbal and written communication skills with and the ability to explain matters to non\-specialists.
 



 ·       Passion for the (re)insurance sector and a good understanding of our industry.
 



 ·       Strong analytical and numerical skills \- to quickly grasp complex issues.
 



 ·       Flexible approach to work and able to adapt to change, team player.
 



 ·       Ability to concentrate and pay attention to detail.
 



 ·       Good IT skills.
 



 ·       Desire to take early responsibilities.
 



 ·       High degree of self\-discipline and commitment.
 



  
 



  
 



 SHOULD WE BELIEVE THAT YOUR PROFILE FITS WITH THE OFFERED POSITION, WE WILL CONTACT YOU WITHIN 15 DAYS. IF YOU DO NOT HEAR FROM US, THEN WE WOULD LIKE TO THANK YOU FOR CONSIDERING SHIELDS AND WE HOPE THAT IN THE FUTURE WE WILL HAVE A POSITION THAT FITS YOUR CAPABILITIES.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 
 The Knowledge Society (TKS) is a global innovation program for ambitious teenagers focused on solving real\-world challenges. Over a 10\-month experience, TKS helps students become capable innovators and leaders by engaging with 40\+ emerging technologies and working on impactful projects with organizations like Microsoft, Interac, and the United Nations. The program emphasizes experimentation, building, and creating meaningful solutions rather than memorization, and is designed by leaders from McKinsey, Google, and Stanford to mirror the culture of top startups like SpaceX and DeepMind. Since 2016, TKS has supported more than 4,000 students across 60\+ countries through in\-person and global virtual programs, cultivating a diverse community centered on leadership, growth, and innovation.  American University of Sharjah invites applicants for a full\-time faculty position at the rank of Professor who will also serve as Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher Bint Mohammed Al Qasimi Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership. The successful candidate is expected to promote interdisciplinary research, innovative teaching and community engagement in women's leadership, advancing understanding of leadership dynamics, gender equity and empowerment. Priority will be given to distinguished scholars with a significant body of work addressing challenges, practices and strategies in women’s leadership across sectors. The Endowed Chair will play a key role in advancing the university mission to foster an inclusive environment, advocating for women’s empowerment and social equity. The selected candidate will be appointed to a full\-time, rolling\-track faculty position within an academic department that aligns with their area of expertise
   

  

**Job Qualifications**
 The Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership is expected to have a PhD (or terminal degree) in one of the disciplines represented in the four colleges/school at AUS; a distinguished record of outstanding intellectual contributions in research and education in Women's Leadership, evidenced by high scholarly productivity and impact; excellence in teaching; proven leadership capability; and familiarity with the cultural context of the region. A successful candidate is expected to contribute to the curriculum at the undergraduate, graduate, post\-graduate and/or professional levels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct and publish original research with an explicit focus on women’s leadership and advancement, women in multicultural and complex societies, or social justice and women’s advancement in the UAE and Gulf.
* Build intellectual community and provide leadership through outreach activities that bring the community in direct contact with scholarly experts, including public discussions, workshops and symposiums.
* Create and help deliver innovative leadership programs that enable women to benefit from the latest leadership insights for the development of personal strategies that build confidence, influence and resilience.
* Advocate for women's issues and gender equity within the academic community.


**APPLICATION PROCEDURE:** 
 To apply, the following documents are requested:
 **(** 
**a)** 
 a cover letter (maximum two pages), outlining your vision for the endowed chair position, your interest in the role, and how your expertise and past experiences related to women’s leadership make you a strong candidate;

**b** 
**)**

**c** 
**)** 
 your curriculum vitae, including your teaching experience and list of publications;

 your teaching philosophy; and

 your research statement.
   

  

 Please apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=CAS\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=CAS\-26\-01\.
   

  

 Review of applicants will begin immediately. For best consideration, apply by February 8, 2026\. The posting is expected to remain open until it is filled. The preferred start date for the role is on or before August 15, 2026\.
   

  

**ABOUT THE UNIVERSITY:** 
 American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on the American models of liberal arts education and thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

You have articulated a transformative academic vision and delivered on it. Your leadership has been direct and visible, not indirect or behind closed doors. In learning science, you are not a casual observer—you have created tangible systems, generated measurable results, and earned credibility to present that work publicly. If this describes your track record, 2 Hour Learning is seeking its chief academic architect.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning has developed a system enabling students to learn at twice the rate in two hours per day. The model relies on AI\-driven tutoring, mastery\-based learning pathways, and a fundamental redesign of traditional classroom frameworks. Outcomes have been consistently strong. We now need a leader to harmonize implementation across varied school environments, elevate academic leadership standards, and represent this rigorous, science\-backed approach on a global stage.
   

  

 This position is not theoretical. It is a directive leadership role. You will control academic strategy in execution, establish explicit performance standards, surface operational shortfalls, and develop high\-performing teams to achieve concrete results. You will operationalize our learning science foundation and advocate for this model worldwide.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Designing academic frameworks that convert learning science principles into actionable direction for curriculum development, student motivation architecture, and application design.
* Conducting academic performance reviews with Heads of Academics to confirm school teams maintain alignment, accountability, and result delivery.
* Integrating data analysis, stakeholder interviews, and direct observation to produce academic ecosystem assessments that identify critical barriers to accelerated learning and recommend targeted solutions.
* Ensuring strategic coherence through planning processes, continuous feedback mechanisms, and milestone monitoring to sustain focus on learning objectives.
* Serving as the principal representative of 2 Hour Learning in high\-stakes forums, including keynote presentations and engagements with Ministries of Education, to influence systemic reform in global education thinking.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Working on standalone curriculum initiatives that lack broader systemic impact.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from student outcomes or operational execution.
* Transferring accountability for performance to middle management or external consultants.
* Depending on institutional credibility or academic theory alone to influence skeptical audiences.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and strengthen 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by standardizing execution across school sites, raising leadership expectations, and serving as the authoritative public advocate for a movement rooted in rigorous science and demonstrated results.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The ERP Transformation Workstream Delivery Manager is responsible for driving the successful delivery and adoption of our ERP transformation programme across multiple business units and locations. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you will coordinate stakeholders, operational teams, technical specialists, vendors, and programme leadership to ensure effective implementation of new systems and ways of working.
   

  

 This is a highly organised, delivery\-focused role requiring strong stakeholder management, governance, risk management, and programme planning skills. As part of the programme leadership community, you will contribute to delivery excellence across the wider transformation programme.
   

  

 Regular travel to UK and international sites will be required to support deployments, stakeholder engagement, and business readiness activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the delivery of ERP transformation activities across multiple sites and business functions, ensuring successful implementation of programme objectives, processes, and technology solutions.
* Drive business change and adoption by engaging stakeholders, coordinating deployment activities, and partnering with business, technical, and vendor teams to ensure alignment and readiness.
* Maintain effective programme governance, reporting, and communications, providing visibility of progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and key decisions.
* Oversee deployment and transition activities, including business readiness, cutover planning, data migration, system integrations, hypercare support, and legacy system decommissioning where required.
* Facilitate workshops, steering groups, and stakeholder forums, while managing risks, issues, and dependencies to support successful programme outcomes.
* Support continuous improvement of programme delivery standards, monitor performance against milestones and budgets, and ensure all programme documentation and governance artefacts are maintained to a high standard.


**About You**
* Proven experience delivering ERP implementations, business transformation, and organisational change programmes.
* Strong understanding of programme governance, project delivery methodologies, and risk, issue, dependency, and change management.
* Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders, influencing across complex matrix organisations.
* Skilled in managing third\-party vendors, system integrators, and cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Self\-motivated, organised, and able to work independently while maintaining alignment with programme objectives.
* Willingness to travel regularly across UK and international sites to support programme delivery, stakeholder engagement, and deployments.


**What You Can Expect**
 At Domino, we offer:
   

  

* A competitive salary and a generous benefits package.
* A supportive culture that encourages ownership and collaboration.
* Career development opportunities in a company that values ambition, expertise, and responsibility.
* Recognition for your contributions in a business that balances global success with a close\-knit team ethos.


 We recognise that flexible homeworking can be beneficial and at Domino we want people to feel able to own the way they work.  What this looks like might vary between teams \- what’s important is that we enable you to get the best from us and for us to get the best from you, whether that’s from your home office or on site, as long as we continue to collaborate and enable great outcomes for our customers.
   

  

 We are a highly successful company, we’re large enough to offer career development opportunities yet small enough for your contribution to be readily recognised and rewarded.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Domino Printing Sciences we do more. Our expertise isn't just in providing cutting\-edge variable data printing technology; it's in revolutionising how manufacturers embrace sustainable packaging and spearhead advancements in coding automation. We’ve been a part of the global variable data printing story for a long time, and our solutions help ensure the success of the world’s leading brands. Our goal is to be the leading global variable data printing brand through applying our expertise and reliable solutions to help the world’s manufacturers be sustainable and cut waste, while attracting, informing, and protecting their consumers. But we also know that it’s not just about the work we do—it’s about fostering a collaborative, dynamic and welcoming environment where everyone can flourish, contributing to Domino not only as a pioneer in the industry but also as an exceptional place to work.
   

  

 Positions may be at an advanced stage of the recruitment process and can close at any time.

data.jd_text:
**The Team**
 We are a global, independent, multi\-disciplinary consultancy delivering sustainable engineering and design solutions across the built environment. With over 1,200 engineers and designers across 29 locations, we apply our expertise to local market conditions to deliver resilient, low\-carbon engineering solutions. We are 100% partner\-owned and are proud to have been named Building Magazine’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022, and 2021\.
   

  

 Our data centre team has been leading mission\-critical design since 2006, delivering over 2,000MW of capacity globally. With a reputation for engineering excellence and sustainability, we’ve partnered with some of the world’s most high\-profile clients to create energy\-efficient, low\-emission data centres that set new standards for resilience and innovation. Recognised as Data Centre Consultancy of the Year in 2025, our team continues to push boundaries in design and delivery.
   

  

 Based in Dubai, this role forms a key part of our growing presence across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). You will play a central role in establishing and expanding our regional data centre capability, working collaboratively with our global network and local partners.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced, client\-focused data centre specialist to establish, develop and grow our data centre capability from Dubai, serving clients and projects across the wider MENA region. For the right candidate, this may represent a step up from their current role; they will be supported in making that transition through close collaboration with regional leadership and access to our established global sector experts. The successful candidate will be expected to combine sector credibility, technical leadership and commercial drive to build a sustainable regional business unit.
   

  

 You will be accountable for the full lifecycle of the sector’s growth and delivery: identifying and mapping priority clients, developing opportunities, leading bids and proposals, shaping project strategies, overseeing multidisciplinary design delivery, and ensuring robust quality assurance and quality control throughout each commission.
   

  

 Working closely with regional leadership and our established global data centre specialists, you will set the direction for the MENA offer, develop trusted client relationships, build a high\-performing local team, and ensure that our technical, commercial and service standards are consistently delivered. You will not be expected to do this in isolation: you will have the support, guidance and technical depth of both the regional leadership team and our global network of sector experts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and grow the data centre business unit in Dubai as a regional platform serving the MENA market.
* Develop a clear regional growth plan, including target markets, priority clients, strategic partners, pipeline opportunities and sector positioning.
* Lead work winning activity, including client mapping, opportunity development, bid strategy, proposal leadership, fee development and commercial negotiation.
* Act as a senior client\-facing representative for the data centre sector, building long\-term relationships with developers, operators, hyperscale clients, investors, contractors and delivery partners.
* Lead multidisciplinary design delivery on data centre projects, ensuring solutions are technically robust, coordinated, buildable, resilient, sustainable and aligned with client requirements.
* Own project delivery governance, including programme, resourcing, risk management, change control, commercial performance, reporting and stakeholder communication.
* Implement and maintain rigorous QA/QC processes, including design reviews, technical approvals, interdisciplinary checks, lessons learned and compliance with relevant standards, codes and Cundall procedures.
* Recruit, mentor and develop engineers and technical specialists, creating a high\-performing team culture that supports growth, accountability and collaboration across the region.


**The Skills**
 You will be a Chartered Engineer, or working towards equivalent professional recognition, educated to degree level in a relevant engineering discipline. You will bring significant consultancy experience, with a proven track record in data centre, mission\-critical, high\-technology or similarly complex MEP\-led projects.
   

  

 The role requires someone who can operate as both a sector leader and a delivery lead: commercially aware, technically credible, highly organised, and confident engaging with senior clients, project teams and regional leadership.
   

  

 You will have demonstrable experience developing client relationships, identifying new opportunities, shaping winning proposals and converting prospects into live commissions. You will also understand how to build delivery teams, set expectations, manage resources and maintain strong commercial performance across multiple concurrent projects.
   

  

 Technically, you will be able to lead and review design outputs, manage multidisciplinary coordination, chair project and design reviews, oversee specifications and reports, and ensure that QA/QC procedures are applied consistently. You will be comfortable balancing hands\-on technical input with strategic leadership, business development and team management responsibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your career at Cundall \- Critical systems \- Publications \- Cundall
   

  

**We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**1\- MISSION** 




  





  





 The Contract Manager is responsible for the effective administration of contracts, ensuring the fair, impartial, and contractually compliant execution of all contractual obligations. The role manages claims, variations, contractual correspondence, and dispute\-related matters, provides strategic contractual and commercial advice to project leadership and proactively mitigates commercial risk to support successful
 



 project delivery.
 



  





  





**2\- LINE AND STAFF RELATIONS** 




  





  





 The Contract Manager will report to the Project Director.
 



  





  





**3\- KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





  






 Contract Administration
 




 • Administer FIDIC suite contracts (including the Red Book and Yellow Book) in direct support of the Consultant who is acting as the Engineer under the Construction Contract, ensuring the independent and impartial discharge of all Engineer's functions in accordance with the applicable conditions of contract.
 



 • Review, assess and issue formal Engineer's determinations and responses to contractual correspondence submitted by the Contractor, ensuring all responses are issued within the contractually prescribed time limits and are contractually precise and well\-reasoned.
 



 • Prepare and issue Engineer's Instructions, Variation Orders, Payment Certificates, and all other formal Engineer's communications in a form that is contractually compliant and defensible.
 



 • Support the preparation and negotiation of contract agreements.
 



 • Monitor and record the Contractor's compliance with its contractual obligations, including programme obligations, submission obligations, notice obligations and performance obligations, and advise the Project Director promptly of any material non\-compliance.
 



  





  






 Claims and Dispute Management
 




 • Maintain records for Employer’s claims, including those related to delay damages.
 



 • Review, analyse and formally respond to all Extension of Time claims submitted by the Contractor, assessing entitlement against the contractual conditions’ precedent, the contemporaneous programme, delay analysis methodology and supporting substantiation.
 



 • Assess Contractor prolongation cost claims and loss and expense submissions, verifying the accuracy, completeness and legitimacy of cost substantiations, calculation methodologies, and causation arguments against the applicable contract provisions.
 



 • Prepare comprehensive Engineer's determinations and Employer defence position papers in response to unmeritorious or overstated Contractor claims, setting out the factual, programme and contractual basis for the Employer's position with precision and authority.
 



 • Maintain a live claims risk register identifying all pending and potential Contractor claims, their financial exposure, the current Employer position and the recommended mitigation strategy.
 



 • Proactively identify and seek to resolve commercial differences and emerging disputes through early engagement, structured commercial negotiation and agreement, with a view to avoiding formal dispute escalation and minimising project disruption.
 



 • Where disputes proceed to formal resolution, prepare and co\-ordinate the production of Engineer's records, position papers, and statements in support of the Employer's case before formal dispute proceedings and arbitral tribunals, as required.
 



  





  






 Variations and Change Management
 




 • Evaluate and assess all proposed Variations, instructed changes and Contractor\-initiated Value Engineering proposals, providing a clear contractual and commercial recommendation to the Project Director in each case.
 



 • Value Variation Orders by reference to the applicable contract rates, bill of quantities, schedule of rates, fair valuation principles or daywork as appropriate, ensuring all valuations represent good value for the Employer and are supportable under the contract.
 



 • Prepare and administer Variation Order forms through to full execution, maintaining a complete Variation register showing instructed, valued and certified status for each Variation.
 



 • Assess the programme and cost implications of all instructed and anticipated Variations, advising the Project Director of the impact on the project budget and completion date before instructions are issued.
 



  





  






 Commercial Management and Cost Control
 




 • Review and assess Contractor interim payment applications, certifying the amount properly due in accordance with the contract and issuing independent Payment Certificates within the contractually prescribed certification periods.
 



 • Monitor and report on project cash flow, contingency spend and cost commitment against approved budget, providing the Project Director with regular and accurate Cost\-to\-Complete forecasts and early warning of budget pressure.
 



 • Provide cost estimates and order\-of\-magnitude assessments for budgeting, change management and value engineering purposes as required by the Project Director.
 



 • Review contractor’s monthly reports and provide recommendations.
 



  





  






 Risk Management and Contractual Advisory
 




 • Provide the Project Director and Employer's senior management with clear, contract\-based guidance on risk allocation, Contractor obligations, and Employer entitlements under the applicable contract, translating complex contractual positions into actionable commercial
 



 advice.
 



 • Maintain and update the project's commercial risk register on a regular basis, translating identified contractual and programme risks into quantified financial metrics and advising on appropriate mitigation measures.
 



  





  






 Records and Document Control
 




 • Maintain a comprehensive and auditable Engineer's contemporary records system, capturing daily site records, resource deployment, weather conditions, delay events, and disruption occurrences in a manner suitable for use in formal dispute proceedings.
 



 • Manage and maintain comprehensive registers for all incoming and outgoing contractual correspondence, Contractor notices, claims, Variation requests, and instructions, ensuring all items are tracked through to formal resolution.
 



  





  






 Procurement and Tendering Support
 




 • Prepare Requests for Proposals, Invitations to Tender, pricing schedules and Bills of Quantities for new procurement packages as and when required.
 



  





  






 Leadership and Stakeholder Management
 




 • Manage, direct and mentor the site\-based commercial team, including Quantity Surveyors and Contract Administrators, establishing clear task allocation, quality standards and output deadlines.
 



 • Conduct regular commercial team meetings, reviewing workload, output quality and progress against key commercial milestones, and escalating resource or performance issues to the Project Director as appropriate.
 



 • Liaise and engage professionally with the Employer's commercial/contract team, the Contractor's commercial representatives and third\-party stakeholders, maintaining constructive working relationships.
 



 • Chair and lead the weekly contract and commercial meetings with the Contractor and Employer’s representative, ensuring robust and correct minutes of meeting are captured and issued to the relevant parties.
 



  





  





**4\- MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** 




  





  





 • Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, Commercial Management or a closely related discipline from a recognised university is required. A postgraduate qualification in Construction Law, Dispute Resolution or Project Management would be an advantage.
 



 • Chartered Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS) is required.
 



 • A minimum of ten (10\) years of post\-qualification experience in contract and commercial management on major infrastructure projects is a must.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in the administration of FIDIC suite contracts (Red Book and Yellow Book, 1999 or 2017\).
 



 • Proven experience on projects valued at not less than USD 500 million (AED 1\.8 billion), with direct responsibility for the contract/commercial management of one or more major contracts within such projects.
 



 • Established track record in airport or aviation infrastructure, including experience on terminal buildings, airside civil works (runways, taxiways and aprons), cargo facilities, MRO facilities or complex aviation systems.
 



 • Direct experience in the preparation, assessment and formal response to Extension of Time and prolongation cost claims, including experience with delay analysis methodologies.
 



 • Solid working knowledge of the UAE and GCC construction market, including familiarity with UAE construction law, standard procurement practices, local regulatory requirements and relevant statutory frameworks.
