data.jd_text:
**Job Requisition ID:** 
 178373
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
 The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing the successful delivery of a single large\-scale construction project, ensuring it aligns with the Project Director’s objectives and organizational strategic goals. The role demands adherence to budget, timeline, and quality standards within a complex and high\-stakes environment. It involves managing multi\-disciplinary teams, navigating regulatory requirements, and fostering effective stakeholder communication to achieve a high standard of project delivery. The Senior Project Manager must employ proactive risk management and commit to continuous improvement, collaborating closely with the Project Director to ensure alignment with broader organizational objectives.
   

  

**What You Will Do:**
 Project Execution and Management
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of a high\-value construction project, ensuring it aligns with the Project Director’s objectives and meets client expectations.
* Ensure the project progresses according to the approved schedule and remains within budget, meeting all programme timelines and financial constraints.
* Oversee all aspects of the project scope, including high\-rise, residential, or commercial components, ensuring alignment with specifications and quality expectations.
* Develop and execute a delivery strategy tailored to the project’s unique needs, ensuring alignment with AFEC’s Business Plan and Long\-Range Financial Plan.
* Set up clear processes and controls for managing project timelines and resources, optimizing delivery timeline while maintaining high standards of quality and cost\-efficiency.
* Establish comprehensive risk management processes to identify, assess, and mitigate risks that could affect project timelines, quality, or profitability.


 Financial Management
   

  

* Oversee the financial aspects of the project, including budgeting, cost forecasting, and implementing financial controls, to ensure alignment with budgetary goals.
* Achieve project profitability targets by managing costs carefully and negotiating favourable subcontractor agreements.
* Ensure diligent contract administration for the project, protecting the company’s financial interests and proactively managing risks associated with cost overruns and delays.


 Leadership and Team Coordination
   

  

* Directly oversee a multidisciplinary team dedicated to the project, ensuring team alignment and cohesion in achieving project goals.
* Recruit, motivate, and retain qualified team members, fostering high performance and accountability within the project team.
* Cultivate a collaborative culture, encouraging open communication and proactive problem\-solving.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards, fostering a professional and compliant project environment.


 Client and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for the client’s project team, maintaining consistent and clear communication.
* Manage client expectations proactively, aligning project delivery with client requirements.
* Act as the liaison between clients, contractors, and internal teams, ensuring clear communication and timely issue resolution.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* Proficiency in project scheduling software such as Primavera P6 or MS Project.
* Skilled in budget management and cost control to identify cost\-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
* Expertise in risk management and quality assurance standards to ensure compliance.
* Excellent communication skills to engage and manage relationships with stakeholders while providing clear, consistent updates.


**What Qualifies You For The Role:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Professional certifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 are preferred.
* 12 to 15 years of experience managing large\-scale construction projects with a demonstrated ability to meet strict timelines and budgets.
* Proven track record of successful project delivery, particularly in managing multidisciplinary teams, including design and procurement, within a construction setting.
* Strong understanding of project management principles, safety standards, and quality assurance practices specific to large\-scale construction projects.


**About Al\-Futtaim Contracting**
 Al\-Futtaim Contracting offers customers complete engineering and systems integration solutions.
   

  

 The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
   

  

 The Technologies division provides complete business solutions to large, medium and small customers that include, contact centre solutions, business applications, business intelligence, data management, advanced analytics amongst others. The IT infrastructure portfolio comprises IP telephony, ELV systems, networking solutions, professional audio\-visual solutions and managed services.
   

  

 These solutions are further complemented by services that include project management, installation, testing, commissioning and after\-sales maintenance contracts.

We deliver world\-class residential and commercial developments, driven by innovation, technical excellence, and a passion for creating inspiring spaces. We
data.jd_text:
We are a global real estate developer with a presence in over 150 offices worldwide and a strong, established footprint across the Middle East. We deliver world\-class residential and commercial developments, driven by innovation, technical excellence, and a passion for creating inspiring spaces. We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Technical Product Manager / Delivery Lead** 
 (Governed Digital \& AI Platform) to join our team in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 We are consolidating its AI and digital products into a single governed enterprise platform: one shared technical spine, a controlled release path, and clear boundaries between the core product, modules delivered by separate teams, and standalone or experimental work.
 



  





 This role owns that platform on the technical side and leads the team that builds it. It is a deliberate hybrid of technical product manager and delivery lead. You set and hold the technical and architectural direction, and you are accountable for delivering it into production and running the engineering team that does the work. It is a hands\-on role, not a coordination seat.
 



  





  





**Reporting and team** 




 Reports to the Head of Strategic Transformation. Leads the platform engineering team (AI engineers, data engineer, graduate developer) and owns its delivery cadence, standards, and growth, including new technical hires. Serves as the technical counterpart to the product managers delivering individual modules, holding the interface contract they build against, and is the single technical owner other teams approach when new work needs a home.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




**Platform architecture and governance** 



* Own and maintain the platform's solution architecture: one governed spine (authentication, APIs, design system, data schema) consumed across every workstream, with isolation boundaries drawn so a failure in one module never destabilises the platform.
* Define and enforce the interface contract that separately built modules must meet before entering any shared environment.
* Keep repository, naming, and URL conventions consistent across the estate so it stays legible and maintainable as it scales.



**Release and deployment** 



* Run the promotion path across Development, UAT, and Production with defined gate criteria at each stage, so nothing reaches production unreviewed.
* Manage batched releases of core components, and land externally built modules behind feature flags so a failing module can be switched off without downtime.
* Migrate the platform from local development into COMPANY's managed environment and keep the deployment pipeline automated and repeatable rather than manual.



**Integration and forward delivery** 



* Onboard incoming modules through contract compliance, integration testing, and a defined graduation gate, protecting the core release cycle throughout.
* Own the forward technical roadmap: scope, sequence, and deliver new capability, and decide what becomes a core release, an integrated module, or a retired experiment.



**Team leadership and delivery** 



* Line\-manage the engineering team: set sprint cadence, review architecture and code, uphold quality and security standards, and develop the team as it grows.
* Remain technical enough to work in the codebase, make architecture decisions, and unblock the team directly.



**Governance and assurance** 



* Ensure every capability that supports live client work is auditable, access\-controlled, and defensible, consistent with COMPANY's governed\-platform standard.



  





**Essential experience** 



* At least eight years in software delivery, including a minimum of four leading engineering or technical product teams that shipped and operated production systems.
* Proven ownership of a multi\-environment deployment lifecycle (Development, UAT, Production), CI/CD, feature flagging, and release governance on a live product.
* A hands\-on engineering background: able to read and review code, reason about API and data\-schema design, and make architecture decisions, not only coordinate those who do.
* Direct line management of developers, including setting standards and running delivery cadence.
* Experience integrating independently built modules into a shared platform without destabilising it, using interface contracts, versioning, and isolation.



**Technical competencies** 



* Modern web application architecture, API design, and data modelling.
* Cloud deployment and environment management; infrastructure\-as\-code and pipeline automation an advantage.
* Working fluency with AI\-assisted development tooling, including Claude Code, and comfort operating an application stack backed by large language models (model routing, prompting, guardrails).
* Version control, branching strategy, and code review at team scale.



**Desirable** 



* Exposure to the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) sector, or a computational design background.
* Experience deploying enterprise AI under governance, audit, or regulatory constraint.
* A record of establishing canonical project and configuration conventions across multiple repositories.



**First\-year outcomes** 



* The platform is fully migrated to the managed environment with a documented, repeatable deployment pipeline.
* The interface contract is published and every new module onboards through it, with no integration destabilising the core platform.
* The Development, UAT, and Production promotion path operates on defined gates with no unreviewed production releases.
* The engineering team runs a predictable release cadence, with new technical hires productive.
* Agreed module deliveries are integrated on schedule against the roadmap.



  





**Scope note:** 




  





 This is a hybrid technical product manager and delivery lead role. Product prioritisation and stakeholder alignment are part of it, but the core accountability is technical: architecture, deployment, governance, and the delivery team. It is not a portfolio\-management or purely coordinating position.

data.jd_text:
Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the Director Experience and Operational Excellence you will lead talabat's end\-to\-end experience function across four pillars — Customer Experience, Partner Experience, Fraud Operations, and CX Insights — spanning 8 markets in MENA. You will be accountable for setting and executing multi\-year strategies that drive customer and partner satisfaction, govern multi\-million EUR budgets with direct P\&L impact, and oversee the integrity of the platform through robust fraud governance.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact senior leadership role requiring the ability to operate at both a strategic and executional level — influencing product and commercial roadmaps, shaping cross\-functional policy, and developing a team of senior managers and specialists. You will serve as a key voice in the COO leadership team, championing data\-driven decision\-making, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building world\-class experiences at scale, this role is for you.
   

  

**WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?**
**Customer Experience Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own the end\-to\-end CX strategy across all verticals (Food, tMart, Local Shops, DineOut) and 8 MENA markets.
* Define and govern cNPS, cSAT, and other north star metrics — setting targets, driving methodology, and leading cross\-functional execution to move them.
* Translate customer data, behavioral trends, and support signals into prioritized initiatives that improve retention, satisfaction, and order frequency.
* Champion process automation, standardization, and digitalization of key CX workflows.


**Partner Experience \& Budget Governance**
* Oversee talabat's Partner Experience function, ensuring vendor satisfaction (vNPS/vSAT) is treated as a strategic competitive differentiator linked to commercial performance.
* Maintain full accountability for the Functional budgets \- customer and vendor compensation program — a multi\-million EUR annual budget — including annual planning, policy design, market rollout sequencing, and ongoing financial governance.
* Govern the complete portfolio of partner\-facing policies and SOPs across all markets and verticals.


**Fraud Operations \& Risk Governance**
* Provide strategic oversight of talabat's Fraud Operations function, covering prevention, detection, and response frameworks across the ecosystem.
* Ensure fraud governance is aligned with compliance, audit, and legal standards.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment between Fraud, Product, Finance, and Legal to balance risk mitigation with customer experience quality and platform growth.


**Insights \& Analytics**
* Oversee the Insights function, ensuring real\-time visibility into performance across all markets through robust dashboards and structured reporting.
* Champion a data\-first culture across the department — ensuring insights translate into action.
* Partner with BI, Data Science, and Product to build the data infrastructure that underpins reliable departmental performance visibility.
* Run primary research, NPS programs to gather structured, well represented qualitative feedback \- using these to inform local and regional priorities


**People Leadership \& Organisational Development**
* Lead and develop a team of middle managers and specialists and analysts.
* Design the department's OKR framework, KPI architecture, and Business Review structure.
* Set clear goals for the function and drive high performance and professional growth across all levels — fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and customer\-centricity.


**Senior Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Serve as the experience authority in senior leadership forums, influencing Product, Commercial, Finance, and Operations decisions.
* Present strategic insights, budget performance, and departmental OKRs to COO and ExCo leadership.
* Lead high\-complexity, cross\-functional programs assigned at department or company level with no existing playbook.


**Qualifications**
**WHAT DID WE ORDER?**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Operations, CX, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in customer experience, operations, or strategy, preferably in e\-commerce, food delivery, or a high\-growth tech environment.
* Proven track record of leading mid level managers and large team members across multiple functions in a matrixed organization.
* P\&L or budget accountability, experience ideally at a multi\-million EUR scale.
* Strong background in data analysis, performance management, and CX or operational strategy.
* Experience working across multiple markets and geographies.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Exceptional leadership skills — able to inspire, align, and develop high\-performing teams.
* Strategic mindset with strong execution discipline; comfortable operating at both the 30,000\-foot and ground levels.
* Data\-driven decision\-making, with the ability to synthesize complex datasets into clear insights and recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills — able to influence and present to ExCo and Board level.
* Deep customer and partner empathy, with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences at scale.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Product, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and drive clarity in complex, fast\-moving environments.
* AI\-first mindset — comfortable leveraging automation and emerging tools to drive scale and efficiency.

data.title: Senior Conflicts Manager (Asia and Middle East)
data.raw_snippet: We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia
data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.



  





 Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. We are committed to a work environment that supports all individuals irrespective of gender, ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. We make every effort to ensure that employment opportunities are open and accessible to all purely on the basis of personal ability.

**Role:** 
 Manager – Retail Delivery
 



**Experience:** 
 10–12 years
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Manager – Retail Delivery** 
 to manage end\-to\-end tenant delivery, fit\-out coordination, authority approvals, and timely store openings across retail, mall, or mixed\-use assets.
 



 The role requires strong coordination with tenants, consultants, contractors, leasing, operations, facilities, and technical teams to ensure every retail unit is delivered in line with approved design, technical, safety, and operational standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage the complete tenant delivery cycle from lease signing to store opening.
* Coordinate tenant fit\-outs, design submissions, technical reviews, inspections, and final handovers.
* Ensure all retail units comply with approved design guidelines, mall standards, safety norms, and authority requirements.
* Track fit\-out milestones, identify delays, resolve issues, and escalate risks on time.
* Coordinate with leasing, mall operations, facilities, MEP teams, consultants, contractors, and tenants.
* Support authority approvals, inspections, and statutory clearances to avoid delays in store openings.
* Maintain progress dashboards, delivery trackers, issue logs, and performance reports.
* Ensure completed units meet design intent, operational readiness, and handover standards.
* Drive continuous improvement in retail delivery processes, tenant experience, and fit\-out governance.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* 10–12 years of experience in retail delivery, tenant coordination, mall fit\-out, retail construction, or mixed\-use development projects.
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Interior Design, or a related discipline.
* Strong knowledge of retail fit\-out standards, mall operations, design coordination, technical submissions, and compliance requirements.
* Experience in managing tenants, consultants, contractors, authority approvals, inspections, and high\-volume store openings.
* Good understanding of UAE/GCC authority procedures, building codes, safety requirements, and Civil Defense regulations preferred.
* Strong project planning, coordination, issue resolution, stakeholder management, and reporting skills.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Vice President, Operations \& Systems, is responsible for defining and executing the P\&T operational systems vision, architecture, and roadmap for all operational systems across the P\&T Pillar. This executive role ensures that operational technology platforms, software applications, integrations, and digital solutions align with business objectives, operational excellence goals, and long\-term growth strategies.
   

  

 The VP leads the development of system strategies, functional and technical specifications, roadmaps, and implementation plans while working closely with business leaders, operations teams, technology teams, vendors, and executive leadership. The role is accountable for maximizing business value through technology innovation, standardization, automation, and scalable digital solutions.
   

  

* Develop and maintain the P\&T strategy for operational systems and software platforms.
* Define the long\-term vision, target architecture, and digital transformation roadmap for operational technologies.
* Align technology initiatives with corporate strategy, operational objectives, customer requirements, and industry trends.
* Act as the executive sponsor for major operational technology and software transformation programs.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies, automation, AI, analytics, IoT, and digital operations.
* Establish governance frameworks for operational systems, software selection, architecture standards, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure consistency, scalability, interoperability, and standardization across operational platforms.
* Define system ownership models, decision\-making processes, and performance measurement frameworks.
* Provide guidance to Business Units, Regional offices and HO with regards to all in\-house P\&T Systems (Zodiac, CCS, Rostering, Oracle, Maximo, Smart Solutions, Business Analytics) and other related technology across Ports and Terminals.
* Implement guidelines, processes, procedures for Terminal Operating Systems smart applications, system utilisation and fine tuning, quality and productivity, over the entire portfolio of terminals.
* Promote collaboration and best practice sharing amongst Business units, setting up TOS user groups and form a centralized TOS knowledge base for system implementation, testing and system migration. Assist the Business Units in selecting and implementing the right systems and related periphery technologies.
* Ensure accurate data collection from each P\&T business across the DP World Portfolio.
* Oversee successful integration globally of all in\-house P\&T Systems.
* Ultimately responsible for successful and customer service issue free go\-live of P\&T systems.Managing and ensuring fluid movement between ideation and project delivery stage, delivering a committed portfolio of Innovation projects and programs that add value.
* Deliver solutions to DP World Group challenges in all disciplines.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Develop and maintain multi\-year operational systems roadmaps aligned with strategic business priorities, capability gaps, modernization opportunities, and future technology requirements.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and return on investment, while monitoring technology trends and recommending strategic investments.
* Define and oversee implementation strategies for new systems, upgrades, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring successful program execution and a smooth transition into operational support and continuous improvement.
* Lead organizational change, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, and user readiness strategies to support successful implementation and sustained value realization.
* Establish enterprise architecture principles and technology standards for operational systems, including cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises solutions where appropriate.
* Ensure seamless integration between operational systems, ERP platforms, customer\-facing applications, data platforms, and third\-party solutions, promoting data consistency, interoperability, scalability, and real\-time information sharing.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into business cases, functional specifications, technical requirements, and solution designs.
* Ensure operational systems and solution designs support current and future business processes while meeting security, compliance, reliability, performance, and design integrity requirements.
* Lead evaluation, selection, and management of software vendors and technology partners for Ports \& Terminals, including negotiation of strategic agreements, monitoring of performance and innovation roadmaps, and management of contractual obligations.
* Govern the commercial and contractual relationship between business units and internal/external system providers.
* Ensure operational systems comply with cybersecurity, regulatory, privacy, and industry standards, and identify, assess, and mitigate technology\-related operational risks.
* Establish business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for critical operational systems.
* Standardize processes and align key performance indicators to reduce customization across system implementations and improve consistency across disciplines.
* Support comparison, selection, and implementation of operational systems and technologies across the Ports \& Terminals portfolio.

**About:** 




 Alef Group is a pioneer in developing premier lifestyle communities, destinations, and experiences through investment and strategic joint ventures, seeking a highly skilled and experienced Manager \- Retail Delivery with specific Retail Delivery management experience to join our team in Sharjah.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Manager – Retail Delivery is responsible for managing the end\-to\-end delivery and operational readiness of retail assets, ensuring seamless transition from project completion to business operations. The role ensures retail spaces are delivered in line with approved designs, quality standards, statutory requirements, and tenant expectations. The position acts as the key link between development, construction, leasing, operations, and facilities management teams to achieve timely handover, minimize delivery risks, and enable successful retail activation.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Retail Asset Delivery \& Handover Management** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end retail delivery and handover process from project completion through operational readiness, ensuring assets are delivered on time, compliant, and ready for activation.
* Coordinate with project teams, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to monitor retail asset progress and achieve successful handover milestones.
* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and de\-snagging activities to ensure retail units and common areas are delivered defect\-free and operationally ready.
* Review project completion status, technical submissions, and handover documentation to ensure all retail assets meet approved requirements before acceptance.
* Drive final inspections, authority approvals, and completion certification processes to achieve timely retail opening readiness.



**Retail Quality, Design \& Compliance Management** 



* Ensure delivered retail spaces comply with approved design standards, brand guidelines, technical specifications, and quality expectations to protect asset value and customer experience.
* Monitor construction quality and delivery standards through regular inspections and audits to identify risks and ensure timely resolution of issues.
* Verify compliance with UAE regulations, authority requirements, health and safety standards, and environmental guidelines to achieve regulatory acceptance.
* Manage the completion and accuracy of retail handover documentation, including as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, warranties, asset registers, and operational records.



**Tenant Delivery \& Operational Readiness** 



* Coordinate with Leasing, Retail Operations, and Facilities Management teams to ensure retail units are prepared for tenant fit\-out, opening, and business operations.
* Facilitate tenant handover activities by ensuring spaces, services, and supporting infrastructure are ready in accordance with agreed delivery requirements.
* Support tenant\-related technical coordination and resolve delivery issues to enhance tenant satisfaction and minimize delays to store opening.
* Establish processes for defect liability period (DLP) management to ensure timely closure of post\-handover issues and maintain service standards.



**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate with Development, Engineering, Design, Construction, Leasing, Finance, and Legal teams to align retail delivery activities with business objectives.
* Act as the primary coordination point between project delivery teams and operational stakeholders to ensure smooth transition from development to operations.
* Resolve delivery challenges and escalate critical risks to management to support timely decision\-making and project completion.
* Coordinate commercial and contractual close\-out activities with relevant teams to ensure completion of outstanding obligations.



**Retail Delivery Performance \& Governance** 



* Develop retail delivery KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track progress, risks, quality, and readiness status.
* Monitor delivery performance against approved timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks to ensure achievement of business targets.
* Prepare regular management reports highlighting delivery status, key risks, mitigation actions, and handover readiness.
* Implement governance processes and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance retail delivery efficiency and stakeholder experience.



**Team Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Lead and manage retail delivery team members, coordinators, and specialists to achieve project handover objectives effectively.
* Develop team capabilities in retail delivery processes, quality management, stakeholder coordination, and operational readiness.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus to improve delivery outcomes and team performance.



  





**Educational Qualifications, Work Experience, and Skills Required:** 




  





**Educational Qualification \& Certifications:** 



* Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, or related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, RICS, LEED, or equivalent are preferred.



  





**Work Experience:** 



* Must have a minimum of 5 years in Retail Delivery management experience with a prominent retail developer in the UAE.
* Must have a proven experience of managing large\-scale retail, commercial, or mixed\-use asset handovers from construction completion to operational readiness.
* Strong understanding of retail development lifecycle, tenant handover requirements, fit\-out coordination, and UAE/GCC construction regulations.



  





**Skills required:** 



* Strong knowledge of retail asset delivery, construction processes, commissioning, and handover management.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong understanding of quality assurance, compliance, and operational readiness requirements.
* Customer and tenant\-focused mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency in ERP systems, CAFM platforms, project management tools, and handover management systems.

This role aims to protect DET’s Information assets from risks, threats, and attacks by establishing robust security policies and aligning them with local and federal mandates,
data.jd_text:
The Senior Manager of Governance is responsible for developing the information security and cybersecurity strategy and plan. This role aims to protect DET’s Information assets from risks, threats, and attacks by establishing robust security policies and aligning them with local and federal mandates, such as those from the Dubai Cyber Security Strategy and the Dubai Electronic Security Center.
 



  





 The responsibilities include managing policy implementation, managing risk assessments, delivering training programs, and ensuring compliance across all technology platforms. Conducting investigations on information security policy breaches and recommending solutions. Coordinating with regulatory bodies and stakeholders to maintain and report on DET’s security posture, ensuring a secure operational environment.
 



  





**Core Functional Responsibilities** 



* Develop the DET Group’s information security and cybersecurity strategy and plan in order to mitigate risks, attacks, and threats on the data assets of the DET Group.
* Design and manage new programs, projects, initiatives, and enhancement and implementation roadmap to strengthen the DET security.
* Manage the Information Security governance process including Policy and Standards across the DET.
* Ensure the alignment of the DET Group’s information security and cybersecurity strategy with local and federal strategies, such as the Dubai Cyber Security Strategy, and other requirements set by DESC. Additionally, maintain compliance with the ISO 27001:2022 standard to uphold international best practices in information security management alongside the ISR.
* Develop and implement of information security and cybersecurity policies, procedures, and standards for the DET Group, ensuring alignment with the ISR as well as leading practices and trends.
* Manage the provision of awareness and training sessions and program to all employees, leaders, strategic partners, etc. on information security and cyber security policies, to mitigate potential policy breaches.
* Conduct thorough and ongoing audits to ensure all employees, leaders, and strategic partners strictly adhere to DET's information security and cybersecurity policies. This includes verifying system access compliance, facilitating cybersecurity training, assessing risks, and maintaining detailed audit trails for continuous improvement and accountability.
* Provide support as needed, to manage any exceptions or deviations from information security and cybersecurity policies.
* Manage the implementation of information and cybersecurity risk assessments on DET Group, in order to gain intelligence on information security and cyber threats and risks DET is vulnerable to, based on its operations and its IT infrastructure components including applications, cloud, cryptography, and infrastructure, and accordingly recommend risk mitigation measures.
* Manage investigations on information security policy breaches conducted internally or through external parties, ensure policy breaches are being accurately reported, and accordingly identify solutions to policy breaches.
* Develop reports pertaining to information security and cybersecurity risk assessments results, as well as incidents related to information security.
* Ensure reports are being circulated to relevant stakeholders, and manage the delivery of presentations to the Director General as well as the Information Security Committee, as needed.
* Provide guidance and advice to end users, when needed, regarding potential threats and key considerations for the safe usage of systems and exchange of information.
* Provide guidance and subject matter expertise when it comes to the enhancement of information security controls, in coordination with the Technology team as well as IT vendors.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.

* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.

* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview:** 




  





 The
 **Project Coordinator** 
 supports the end\-to\-end delivery of the King's College Hospital London, UAE (KCH UAE) Billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) System Replacement initiative, from vendor selection and requirement gathering through configuration, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, go\-live and post\-go\-live stabilisation.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the Director of RCM, this Dubai\-based role works alongside the Implementation Project Manager from Information Technology. While the Project Manager leads technical delivery, integration and the overall project plan, the Project Coordinator owns the business\-side coordination: keeping deliverables on track, driving workflow and process optimisation across RCM, Billing and Front Office, maintaining accurate project status, and preparing clear, timely updates for the Steering Committee.
 



  





 The role requires strong organisational and coordination ability, a working understanding of healthcare revenue cycle and billing operations, and the ability to act as the connective tissue between business users, the IT Project Manager, the selected vendor and senior stakeholders throughout the implementation.
 



  





***Key Accountabilities:***




  





**Project Coordination, Tracking \& Governance Support** 



* Maintain the master project tracker for the RCM and Billing system replacement, keeping milestones, deliverables, dependencies and action items current and accurate at all times.
* Support the Implementation Project Manager and Project Owner in maintaining the integrated project plan across the five delivery phases: Requirement Gathering \& Gap Analysis, System Configuration \& Integration, UAT, Training \& Go\-Live, and Post\-Go\-Live Support.
* Track progress against the agreed timeline, proactively flag slippage, overdue actions and emerging risks, and follow up with owners to keep the project on schedule.
* Maintain the project RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and ensure items are owned, updated and escalated appropriately.
* Coordinate and minute project meetings: capture decisions and action items, circulate notes, and follow through to closure.



  





**Deliverables Management \& Documentation** 



* Coordinate and quality\-check project deliverables from business teams and the vendor against agreed scope, format and timelines before submission or sign\-off.
* Maintain a single, version\-controlled repository of project documentation: requirement documents, workflows, SOPs, configuration sign\-offs, test scripts, training material and meeting records.



  





**Workflow Optimisation \& Process Improvement** 



* Lead and document workflow optimisation across RCM, Billing, Pre\-Authorisation, Claims, Collections and Front Office, mapping current\-state processes and designing improved future\-state workflows aligned to the new system.
* Work with business users to identify manual handoffs, duplication and revenue\-leakage points, and translate these into clear process and configuration requirements for the vendor and IT Project Manager.



  





**Steering Committee \& Stakeholder Reporting** 



* Prepare clear, accurate and timely Steering Committee updates, including status dashboards, milestone tracking, risk and issue summaries and decision logs, for review by the Project Owner.
* Consolidate inputs from business workstreams, the IT Project Manager and the vendor into a single, coherent project status view using Red\-Amber\-Green (RAG) reporting



  





**Vendor \& Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Act as a day\-to\-day coordination point between business teams, the IT Project Manager and the selected vendor, ensuring queries, dependencies and action items are routed and resolved promptly.



  





**UAT, Training \& Go\-Live Coordination** 



* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing from a business standpoint: organise test scenarios and scripts, schedule testers, track defects and retests, and maintain the UAT status log through to sign\-off.



  





**Quality, Governance and Professional Standards (JCI\-Aligned)** 



* Carry out all duties in line with Joint Commission International (JCI) accreditation, safety, quality and organisational requirements relevant to the role.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient, staff and organisational information at all times, and comply with DHA data protection, NABIDH and applicable UAE data residency and privacy requirements.



  





**Organisational Responsibilities** 



* Perform any additional duties reasonably assigned by the organisation or line manager, even if not explicitly listed in this job description, to meet operational needs and support departmental and organisational objectives.
* Comply with all organisational and departmental policies, procedures, legal requirements and applicable regulations at all times, and take personal responsibility to read, understand, follow and keep updated with the latest versions.



  





***Education \& Qualification, Experience, Training \& Knowledge***




  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Information Systems, Finance or a related field (MANDATORY).
* CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2 Foundation or equivalent project management certification (PREFERRED / ADVANTAGEOUS).
* Certification or formal training in healthcare RCM, medical coding, process improvement or Lean Six Sigma (ADVANTAGEOUS).



  





**Experience** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, billing, insurance or related operations, preferably in the UAE (ESSENTIAL).
* Demonstrated experience coordinating or supporting projects, ideally healthcare IT or system\-implementation projects (ESSENTIAL).
* Exposure to RCM/billing system implementations, UAT coordination, workflow mapping or SOP development (HIGHLY PREFERRED).
* Familiarity with the UAE healthcare and insurance landscape, including DHA/DOH regulatory requirements and DHPO/eClaimLink processes (PREFERRED).
* Experience working with Cerner/Oracle Health or comparable hospital information systems (ADVANTAGEOUS).



  





**Training \& Knowledge:** 




  





**Revenue Cycle \& Billing Operations:** 
 Working knowledge of the end\-to\-end revenue cycle, including registration, eligibility, pre\-authorisation, coding, claims submission, denial management, resubmission, reconciliation and collections.
 



**Project Coordination:** 
 Practical understanding of project coordination, deliverable tracking, RAID/issue logs, status reporting and meeting governance.
 



**Tools:** 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and project tracking tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira or equivalent.
 



**Process \& Documentation:** 
 Ability to map workflows, document SOPs, and translate operational processes into clear, structured requirements.
 



**Regulatory Awareness:** 
 Awareness of DHA/DOH/MOH requirements, NABIDH, data protection and JCI standards relevant to healthcare IT in Dubai.

data.jd_text:
**About TBH** 




 At TBH, we dream of transforming communities and improving lives, by providing innovative solutions to our clients most complex problems.
 



  





 As leaders in our field and trusted advisors, we have provided specialist project management services to the public and private sectors on over 8,000 landmark projects across Asia\-Pacific and the Middle East. Our portfolio spans both domestic and international projects, including significant opportunities in Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates, where we are heavily invested.
 



  





 TBH has been growing rapidly in The Middle East and internationally, but continues to be a connected, collaborative and supportive team. We have set our strategy looking ahead to 2030, to ensure we continue to meet the needs of clients and set ourselves up as a business for the future.
 



  





**About the Opportunity** 




 We are seeking a Senior Consultant, with a strong client\-side/developer background, complemented by contractor execution experience, to provide strategic planning and project controls advisory services on major residential, commercial, hospitality and mixed\-use developments across the UAE.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have managed projects through the full development lifecycle, from initiation, design, procurement, authority approvals and sales launch through to construction and handover, providing strategic advice to clients and senior stakeholders. They will also have experience in assessing delay and disruption events, preparing and reviewing extension of time claims, and supporting dispute\-related commissions.
 



  





 We are looking for professionals who enjoy working with diverse stakeholders, bring a self\-driven mindset, and demonstrate strong leadership in proactively solving problems and addressing project requirements.
 



  





 As our Senior Consultant you’ll be responsible for;
 



  




* Leading the implementation of project schedules and plans, with client objectives and project milestones
* Developing strong working relationships with clients and stakeholders by communicating clearly, professionally, and consistently to enhance collaboration and project outcomes
* Providing mentorship and on\-the\-job guidance to junior team members, contributing to a collaborative and high\-performing project team environment
* Reviewing, interpreting and analysing data from multiple sources, and tailoring reporting outputs to inform project leadership and stakeholder decision\-making
* Managing the end\-to\-end preparation of client\-facing deliverables, including detailed analysis, technical reports and presentation material, ensuring readiness to respond to client queries
* Preparing, maintaining, and analysing complex schedules using planning tools such as Primavera P6, supported by clear reporting outputs tailored to stakeholder needs
* Applying industry best practice planning and scheduling methodologies to identify and address project risks, constraints and opportunities
* Identifying and implementing project controls best practices to overcome planning challenges and improve delivery outcomes
* Supporting knowledge sharing and capability uplift through technical workshops with senior team members and contribution to client training sessions where required
* Seeking and championing continuous improvement and process innovation across planning and scheduling activities to enhance project efficiency and effectiveness
* Ensuring all outputs meet the highest standards of accuracy, quality and consistency, and incorporating feedback and quality checks as part of standard delivery practice



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 As our successful candidate you'll demonstrate and bring the following skills and expertise:
 


* 8\+ years’ relevant experience in Planning, Scheduling, Project Controls and Claims Management.
* Relevant qualifications in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Architecture or equivalent
* Minimum 3 years of client\-side/developer experience in the Middle East.
* Proven experience managing projects across both pre\-construction and construction, from initiation through design, procurement, authority approvals, sales launch, construction and handover.
* Hands\-on contractor experience, with involvement in the execution of at least one complete lifecycle of a construction project.
* Ability to advise clients on packaging strategies, procurement approaches and project phasing scenarios.
* Sound working knowledge of authority approval processes across pre\-construction and construction.
* Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6\.
* Hands\-on experience developing interactive reporting systems and dashboards using Power BI.
* Excellent English communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex programmes and interdependencies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.



  





**Why work at TBH** 




 At TBH, we are ACHIEVEMENT and outcome focused, operating with aligned strategic intent and delivering on our promises to ensure optimum results for our clients. Additionally, our ONE TEAM culture drives us to operate with one way of working that fosters care and collaboration.
 



  





 Through our strong values, TBH is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can feel comfortable to be their full selves at work. We value people from different backgrounds and all walks\-of\-life as we believe our collective experience inspires blue\-sky thinking and creative solutions.
 



  





**What TBH can offer you** 




 Along with a competitive salary plus bonus, and limitless opportunity to progress your career and passions with us, TBH also offers employees:
 


* **Flexible working** 
 \- we understand employees may need to adjust their working arrangements for personal reasons or to “work from anywhere” for a fixed or indefinite period.
* **Inclusive culture** 
 \- at TBH, we’re committed to fostering an environment where all individuals feel valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.
* **Career development** 
 \- employees are supported with their career development through on\-the\-job training and mentorship, in\-house training programs and financial support for approved industry institutions and associations.
* **Health \& wellbeing** 
 \- all employees have access to our Employee Assistance Program, TELUS Health, an independent, confidential service to help you to improve your health and wellbeing, resolve challenges and reach your goals. Annual flu vaccinations are also offered by TBH.
* **Social events** 
 \- a range of social events and company\-sponsored sporting events take place throughout the year to help employees build connections with others across the organisation.
* **Reward and recognition** 
 \- TBH employees are recognised for their contributions through our Award programs, remuneration packages and promotion opportunities.

The incumbent will plan, coordinate, and deliver project works from handover to closure in line with company policies and client expectations.
   

  

**Key responsibilities: Project Operations and Delivery**
* Execute all operational works on multiple project sites simultaneously from handover through to project closure, including mobilization, procurement, installation, commissioning, monitoring, and demobilization.
* Plan and execute all activities in accordance with the Method Statement, contracted scope, best practices, and client obligations. Report any variances to the Line Manager prior to execution.
* Maintain complete and accurate site documentation, including:


  – Delivery Notes

  – Damage Reports
   

  

  – Stop Reports

  – Daily Activity Reports
   

  

  – System History Reports
   

  

  – Toolbox Talks

  – Project Status Report – Daily

**QHSE**

* Promote safety targets and zero tolerance for unsafe practices or conditions.

* Review relevant project specifications before work commences and monitor all activities to ensure quality and accuracy as per company standards.

**Cross\-Functional Support / Training**

* Collaborate with internal project stakeholders to resolve contract, documentation, and execution risks.
* Identify problems and opportunities, escalating critical issues to the Line Manager.
* Assist the Line Manager in preparing a six\-month rolling manpower plan and justify resource requirements.

**Qualification Requirements**

* Postgraduate study in Surveying, Engineering, or MRICS certification is an asset.

**Job Description**

 As a Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects, with a focus on retail and mixed\-use developments, from early concept through to completion.
   

  

 The role requires a highly proactive and commercially astute approach, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, brand requirements, operational constraints, and fast\-track retail programmes. You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.

 Contract \& Scope

 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders

* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)

* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes

 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management

* Develop and implement mitigation strategies

 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 13\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a Head of Pre\-Construction to lead our pre\-construction function across a diverse portfolio of design\-and\-build projects. This is a senior leadership role focused on construction\-led design management, buildability, technical coordination, risk management, and early project strategy.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have the ability to bridge design intent and delivery execution, ensuring projects are commercially viable, technically robust, and efficiently delivered. A strong understanding of how design decisions impact programme, procurement, sequencing, risk, and site execution is essential.
   

  

 If you have a proven track record of leading pre\-construction teams and driving successful project outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the pre\-construction function from bid stage through to handover to project delivery teams.
* Drive pre\-construction strategy for design\-and\-build projects, ensuring alignment between client requirements, consultant design, commercial objectives, and construction methodology.
* Manage and oversee design coordination during tender and pre\-award stages, with a strong focus on buildability, technical compliance, and delivery risk.
* Provide leadership on contractor\-led design development, ensuring that design solutions are practical, cost\-effective, and aligned with programme and procurement constraints.
* Review drawings, specifications, and technical submissions to identify gaps, inconsistencies, coordination issues, and potential delivery risks.
* Lead value engineering and design optimization workshops to improve efficiency, reduce cost, and strengthen constructability without compromising quality or performance.
* Work closely with estimating, commercial, procurement, planning, and operations teams to develop integrated pre\-construction solutions.
* Support tendering and bid management activities, including methodology development, technical submissions, design narratives, risk reviews, and interview preparation.
* Oversee external consultants, design managers, and specialist subcontractors involved in the pre\-construction and design development process.
* Establish strong working relationships with clients, consultants, and internal project stakeholders to ensure clear communication and effective decision\-making.
* Ensure robust governance of design deliverables, approvals, authority requirements, and pre\-construction milestones.
* Lead the transition of projects from pre\-construction into live delivery, ensuring continuity of design intent, technical understanding, and risk management.
* Mentor and develop the pre\-construction and design management team, building capability across technical, commercial, and leadership disciplines.


**Candidate Profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline, MCIOB.
* 10\-15 years experience in pre\-construction, design management, or technical management within a main contractor environment.
* Strong track record in design\-and\-build project delivery, ideally across complex and geographically challenging building projects.
* Demonstrable experience managing design development from a contractor’s perspective, with a clear understanding of construction methodology and buildability.
* Strong technical knowledge across architectural, structural, and MEP coordination.
* Commercial awareness with the ability to balance quality, programme, and cost considerations during design development.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing external consultants and specialist subcontractors.
* Strong understanding of international standards, codes of practice processes, technical approvals, and construction regulations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to operate strategically while remaining hands\-on in technical and design\-related matters.

**Overview**
**Impact the Moment**
 McGraw Hill is a leading global provider of education solutions for K\-12, higher education, and professional learning. We've been at the forefront of education for over 130 years, and we're reimagining how learning happens through innovative technology and content. Our products reach millions of learners globally.
   

  

**About the Opportunity:**
 McGraw Hill is seeking a visionary
 **Vice President of International Product** 
 to lead our global Higher Education product strategy and drive product\-market\-fit across international markets. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of education technology on a global scale, building a world\-class product organization that serves diverse markets, cultures, and educational systems.
   

  

 As a member of the Higher Education Product Leadership Team, you'll report directly to our Chief Product Officer and have a powerful voice in defining how McGraw Hill innovates and competes globally. This role combines strategic product leadership, cross\-functional team management, and organizational culture\-building into a single high\-impact position.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
**Own International Product Strategy**
 Develop and maintain compelling regional product strategies that achieve product\-market\-fit across geographies. You'll evaluate and optimize multiple variables—content, platform capabilities, commercialization models, and revenue strategies—to ensure viability and growth.
   

  

**Lead and Develop International Product Teams**
 Manage product team members globally. You'll build a connected, empowered team that embodies McGraw Hill's culture while maintaining a global perspective. This includes fostering collaboration, mentorship, and professional development across distributed teams.
   

  

**Shape the Product Roadmap**
 Influence our global product roadmap through compelling business cases, persuasive ROI analysis, and attractive revenue opportunities. You'll advocate for regional priorities while understanding how they fit into our broader product vision.
   

  

**Drive Localization Excellence**
 Establish and lead a cross\-functional Center of Excellence responsible for defining world\-class localization practices. From content adaptation to platform customization to go\-to\-market strategies, you'll drive competitive advantage and speed\-to\-market across all regions.
   

  

**Manage Strategic Partnerships**
